In youtube_transcript_api v0.6+, the API is `YouTubeTranscriptApi().fetch('L1vXCYZAYYM')` or `YouTubeTranscriptApi.list_transcripts('L1vXCYZAYYM')`. Let's test `fetch` or `list`.
```python
res = await run_command("python -c \"from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi; ytt = YouTubeTranscriptApi(); t = ytt.fetch('L1vXCYZAYYM'); print(t[:10])\"")
print(res)
```
